title: fix(lint,rest)!: i18n extract/check expect the _relatedLists keys os validate accepts under a .custom arrangement, and the object read translates a tab title the arrangement sets
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoPitZDb578jbruHjEfhUY3D)_

Fixes #37622

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: follow-up #38128

## 维护者速读
- 定制包改过或新加了相关列表标签页标题时，翻译键命令和校验现在给出一样的结论；记录页上这类标题也会按定制包自己的译文显示，以前一直显示原文。
- 替给客户定制包做翻译的人解决两件事：覆盖率检查要求一个校验会拒收的键，永远过不了；定制包里新写的标签页标题翻了也不显示。
- 用 `--strict` 跑覆盖率检查的项目，可能新报缺少定制包标签页标题的译文，补上即可。显示侧最坏是某个标签页标题换成了定制包的译文。都可以直接撤回。
- 这是收窄，需要审批人批准；契约审核在 7ddcc646 上通过，没有必须改或应该改的项。d830f5af 只合入了 main，本 PR 自己的改动没有变。

## What changes

**`os i18n extract` / `os i18n check` agree with `os validate` (card item 1).**

- New `packages/lint/src/related-list-titles.ts`: the ONE fold of an object's record-page tab titles as the registry serves them. It runs the owner's `relatedLists` first, then every list placement, then the paired `.custom` arrangement. Each arrangement entry replaces every entry it covers (`relatedListNameCovers`), in two passes per arrangement. It answers `labels` (list → served label + the layer that wrote it), `names`, `hidden` and `stripped`. The logic was lifted unchanged from `validate-translation-references.ts`, where it lived inline.
- `validate-translation-references.ts` reads that fold. The rule's verdicts are unchanged; the 36595 pins and the full lint suite pass as before.
- `i18n-walk.ts` `pushRelatedListLabels` (the walker behind `collectExpectedEntries`, which both CLI commands call) reads the same fold over the stack's `objectExtensions`:
  - no key over a list the arrangement hides, names bare or re-states without a `label`;
  - one key, carrying the arrangement's text, over a list the arrangement labels;
  - still no key for a label only a code extender's `place` entry gives. The rule accepts that key, but the registry does not apply a placement on a target with no `relatedLists`, or on a list the owner already names.
- It lives beside `object-graph.ts`, not in it. That file's receivers are tabled by the security-posture rule's key-read meta-test, which this fold is no part of.
- `packages/cli` is unchanged.

**The object read translates a tab title the arrangement sets (card item 2, seat route R1).**

- `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`, new `objectPairRelatedListsBundleOf`. It is used by both `/meta/object` reads, `translateMetaDocument` (by name) and `translateMetaList` (list).
  - An object still answers no `servedOverrideBaseOf` (ADR-0146 D10, unchanged). Instead, the read takes the pair of the base the object's packaged base ships in (`packagedBase._packageId`, the base `withoutStaleObjectPlural` already reads) and calls `getPairTranslationBundle` through the same per-page memo.
  - Only the `objects.OBJECT._relatedLists` subtree of each locale is handed on, as the existing `pairBundle` option.
  - The pair is asked only when the served object carries a tab title that diverges from the packaged base (`hasRelatedListTitleOffBase`, the divergence `translateObjectRelatedLists` judges a title by). An object list where no arrangement changed a tab title pays no new translation read, which keeps the ADR-0090 D10 statement budget pinned by `packages/runtime/src/mcp-list-objects-statements.pin.test.ts`.
  - A tab title that diverges from the packaged base now reads the pair's translation, then keeps its own text. On such an object, a title equal to the owner's reads the pair's translation first, then the deployment's, interleaved by locale, as the spec's `labelCatalogs` already orders it. On an object where no title diverges, every title reads the deployment catalog, as before; that catalog already holds the pair's share.
  - Every other string of the object keeps the ranking it had. A slice that answers nothing for an object string reads exactly as no `pairBundle`; the scope pin below holds this.
- No new export and no new option: `TranslateDocumentOptions` and `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` are untouched.

**Review follow-ups N2–N4.**

- N2: a pin for `{ list: 'event.related_to', hidden: true }` beside a bare `'event'` (both orders). The wrong test comment that said the schema refuses that shape is removed.
- N3/N4:
  - The two `translation-target-unknown` hints now name the list the key addresses (`{ list: 'LIST', label }`) instead of "the owner's `label`".
  - The stripped message says "replaces the entry that labelled it".
  - The ledger entry `translation-related-list-key-under-arrangement-refused`: its `surface` says "the owner or a list placement labels". Its `replacement` no longer claims a translated title needs the owner's label, which this PR makes false.
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx`: the `_relatedLists` row says the same.
- `packages/objectql/src/registry-related-lists-label-translation-36528.test.ts`: the header now says how the REST read builds the pair bundle, instead of claiming it did when it did not.

Changeset: `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/rest` and `@objectstack/spec` patch, with the BREAKING note for the coverage gate's expected key set and an ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` disposition.

## Tests

- `packages/lint/src/i18n-related-lists-arrangement-36595.test.ts` (the existing harness):
  - New top-level `describe` "collectExpectedEntries — _relatedLists agree with the rule". Over nine arrangements, every key the extractor scaffolds is translated and judged by `validateTranslationReferences`, and none is refused.
  - The scaffolded keys and their source text are pinned per arrangement.
  - A placement-only label is not asked for and is still accepted.
  - The N2 pin. The no-label hint assertion now expects `{ list: 'contact', label }`.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-object-related-list-pair-i18n.test.ts` (new; the real `SchemaRegistry` / protocol / `RestServer` harness of `meta-object-extension-plural-label.test.ts`, pair `translation` rows read through `getPairTranslationBundle`), on both `/meta/object` reads:
  - The pair translates a relabelled tab and a newly titled one in `zh-CN`; `en`, which the pair does not translate, keeps the arrangement's text.
  - A title the pair does not translate keeps its own text, never the base's translation of another string.
  - Scope: an extension's renamed object `label` is NOT translated by the pair's `label` row, while its tab title is.
  - Controls: with no arrangement, and with one that keeps the owner's title. The deployment translation serves, and the pair's own translation serves first where it ships one.
  - Statement budget: the pair's catalog is asked 0 times for an object with no arrangement or one that keeps the owner's title, and more than 0 times for one that relabels.
- `packages/cli/test/i18n-coverage.test.ts`: two cases, the zh keys `os i18n check` expects under an arrangement, and a control.

<details><summary>Readings (branch cut from origin/main 815e882b, origin/main merged at d830f5af; head d830f5af)</summary>

  - Real `translateMetaDocument` and `translateMetaList` served `['Notes', '任务']`: the arrangement's `Notes` was untranslated, though the pair ships `笔记`. `servedOverrideBaseOf('object', served)` returned `undefined`, and the pair bundle was asked 0 times.

At fe0f53eb it failed 1 of 20 (memo `list_objects` 31 statements at 150 objects against a bound of 24), and with the pair arm ablated it passed 20 of 20. That failure was this PR's, and 7ddcc646 fixes it;
  - `@objectstack/cli` `test/i18n-coverage.test.ts`: `Tests 32 passed (32)`.
- `turbo build --force` of the lint, rest and objectql closures (dts included): 32/32. `typecheck` exit 0 for `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/objectql`. `@objectstack/spec check:generated`: "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date".

At 7ddcc646 these were re-run: the rest suite above, rest `tsc --noEmit` exit 0, `eslint` on the two files exit 0, and `check-engine-double-contract` exit 0. `fe0f53eb` added the new pin's `findOne` row to `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`; its absence was the engine-double-contract red at 48c654cc.
- Head d830f5af merges `origin/main` into 7ddcc646. The merge had no conflicts. `git diff 7ddcc646 d830f5af` over this PR's own files is empty, so the net diff is unchanged; the code readings above at 7ddcc646 stand for it.

## Acceptance notes

- A label only a code extender's `place` entry gives is accepted by `translation-target-unknown` but not scaffolded by `os i18n extract`. This is deliberate, and it is the harmless direction: the registry does not apply a placement on a target with no `relatedLists` or on a list the owner already names, so asking for it could ask for a string no screen shows. Whether the rule should refuse those keys is a separate narrowing, not taken here.
- The public form route (`form-routes.ts`) still translates its object with no pair bundle. A public form renders no record-page tabs, so the gap does not reach a screen; its comment stays true.
- The pair's tab-title translations also outrank a tenant overlay's own tab label (a `sys_metadata` object row that relabels a tab). This is the ruled order of ruling record 6631250894: a pair translation, then the override's own text.
- Skills: `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` (the `_relatedLists` row) and `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` (line 359) still say the remedy is to re-state the entry "with the owner's own `label`". That is still correct but no longer the only way, because the object read now translates any arrangement label through the pair. The follow-up is filed as #38128; see `Skills-docs:` above.
- Dogfood battery (`(narrowing)` arm and `!` title), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under `os-verify-lock` on the landing head d830f5af. It ran after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and a build of the dogfood closure (`@objectstack/dogfood^...`, `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/client-react`), because the merge brought in main's lockfile and version moves. Result: `VERDICT command-exit 0` (held the lock 2166s, shared-box seconds), `Test Files 490 passed | 3 skipped (493)`, `Tests 4144 passed | 68 skipped (4212)`. The same battery read the same counts at 7ddcc646 and at fe0f53eb.

## Verification

Read first (by risk):
1. `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`: `objectPairRelatedListsBundleOf` and its two call sites. This is the served-read change: check that only the `_relatedLists` subtree is handed on.
2. `packages/lint/src/related-list-titles.ts`: the fold, lifted from the rule. Diff it against the removed block of `validate-translation-references.ts`.
3. `packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts`: `pushRelatedListLabels`, and which layer it skips.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/meta-object-related-list-pair-i18n.test.ts` should show 6 passing. Delete the `?? (await objectPairRelatedListsBundleOf(…))` arm of the by-name read and the same command should show the by-name pins failing.
